name: Photopea
summary: Free browser-based photo editor that opens and saves PSD files and 40+ other formats.
description: Photopea is an online image editor that runs entirely in the browser; files never leave the device. It supports layers, masks, layer styles, filters, vector graphics, RAW files and AI background removal, and opens and saves PSD plus 40 other formats. Free to use, with a Premium account that removes ads; free PSD templates and an embedding API are also offered.
contains: runs fully in the browser; files never leave the device
opens and saves PSD + 40 other formats
layers, masks, layer styles, adjustment layers, channels, paths
levels, curves, liquify, puppet warp and other filters
AI background removal and text-described content fill
